what_happened: Launched deploy-headless.sh in the background and continued editing Phase 4's source files (runtime-file-patterns.sh, the standards doc) before it finished. The deployed tree captured a partial edit state, causing test-runtime-file-tracking.sh (which resolves .claude/ before the source store) to see a stale 20-member lib paired with a stale standards doc and fail Case 5. Also surfaced an unrelated pre-existing specs/TODO.md sync drift from task 329's own earlier IMPLEMENTING status transition not yet regenerated into TODO.md.
